reasoning: The complete bipartite graph K_{6,7} with partition A = {0,1,2,3,4,5} and partition B = {6,7,8,9,10,11,12} is a maximal triangle-free graph on 13 vertices. It is triangle-free because all edges go between the two partitions (no two vertices in the same partition are adjacent, so no triangle can form). It is maximal because adding any edge between two vertices in the same partition (say u,v both in A) would create a triangle u-w-v for any w in B, since both u and v are connected to all vertices in B. The graph has 6×7 = 42 edges.
